tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List the products CanWeShip checks, each with the first sentence of its answer, verification date and guide URL. Pass query to search product names, aliases and named products such as iPhone 15 or aerosol deodorant; each named product says which product check answers for it.

tools.name: get_product_guidance
tools.description: Get preliminary U.S. domestic shipping guidance for one product: the answer with claim-level source IDs, the facts check_product accepts (ids, types, allowed values), carrier context, review dates and the cited official sources. Accepts product slugs, named products and aliases. FAQs, rule evidence

tools.name: check_product
tools.description: Evaluate supplied product facts through the same deterministic USPS, UPS and FedEx rule runtime used by the CanWeShip checker. Use the fact ids from get_product_guidance questions.
